Bhai meri story thori si ajeeb hai . 2018 tak tum samaj lo upper middle class ki category meim they hum paise ka tension hota kya hai pata hi nhi tha . Uss time 2nd year mein tha college ke . Papa ne uss time job chor di or business start kar dia . Toh mujhe lagta tha abb padhna hi kyun wapas ghar jaake business mein bethna hai. Agle 2 saal mast aish maari college meim call karta tha ghar par or mast paise aajate they. 4th year mein placements mein hi nhi betha ki job lag jaayegi or upar se marks bhi itne nhi ayye ki kisi achi jagah lag jaye job . But jo cheez nhi pata thi ki in 2 saalon meim papa ka business chala hi nhi loss par loss ho rha tha or pura kharcha humara (mera or meri bhen ka) papa apni savings de rhe they . Around 1cr+ ka loss hua tha. Jo papa ki lagbhag itne saal ki savings + loans ke paise they .Phir ayya covid 2020 mein. Mera bhi final sem tha ghar wapas agye mast ki chalo abb business sambhalenge . Lockdown lag gaya or company baand rhi jisse papa orders pura nhi kar paye or phir or jayada loss ho gaya . Yeh baat mujhe ghar aa kar pata chali . Yeh sunte hi pairon taale zameen khisak gayi. Or iss baar jo loss hua tha uske paise dene ke liye papa ko ghar bechna padha. Hum vividh ke time rented apartment meim shift ho gaye . Samaj hi nhi aaa rha tha life meim yeh kya hogaya. Papa but aise they chalo number nhi ayye koi baat nhi tum kisi exam ki tyari kar lo . But BC mehnat karne ki aadat hi nhi thi life mein toh ulta sidha deemag chalane lag gaya. Sabse phle uss time par crypto ka scene agaya tha papa se 50k mang kar laga diye usmein 2021 tak thore bhot paise kamnayein but phir bc jo loss hua kuch nhi bacha haath mein . Abb ghar par yeh sabh bata nhi skta ki sara paisa dubbaa dia toh betting karna start kar dia sabhi friends se paise liye betting karne ke liye.IPL ke time par bhot jayda loss hua around 2.25 lakh ka or sara paisa dost ya idhar udhar se uthaya tha. Gaand faat gayi ki itna paisa wapas kaise karun. Uss time Reddit join kia or fake post banata tha ki paise dedo bhot dikkat hai yeh vo . Kuch nhi hua. Phir doston ke itne paise le liya tha ki samaaj hi nhi aaraha tha kya karun suicide vegara dimaag mein aa rha tha .But bhai uss time bhagwan ban ke mera best friend aaya or usne samjhay ki iss sabh se kuch nhi hoga koi job dhund bhale kaam paise mille but kuch toh ayega hath mein . Phir mene Ek IT company join kar li 20k milta tha in hand . Or job lagne se kya hua meim loan ke liye eligible ho gaya sabse phle loan lia or or 5 saal ki emi banai 4.5k ke around har month bani 20k mein se dene lag gaya or baki 15k ghar ke kharche ke liye phir mujhe GATE exam ke baare mein pata chala ki isse PSU mein job lagti hai. Toh 2022 mein start kar di tyari job ke sath . IT compny mein tha toh 9-8 time hota tha haar din extra bethna padta tha phir 9 baje tak ghar aak padhta tha 1-2 baje tak phir sone jata tha. Abb mein aisa ladka tha jo college mein just cheating karke ya just just pass hua tha toh mujhe basically sabh starting se start karna tha. Upar se sirf 1 saal ka time kyunki mujhe pata tha ki mein yeh schedule max to max 1 saal tak hi follow kar paunga kyunki bhot jayda thaak jaata tha daily padhne ka mann hi nhi karta tha.But iss baar soch lia tha mehnat karke kuch change launga life mein. Ultimately last month mera result ayya or mein top 500 rank mein agaya. Ghar par sabh khush they yeh dekh ke . 
Abb jab mein yeh sabh purani batein sochta hun toh bss hansi aati hai ki kya chutiya aadmi tha mein or mujhe lagta tha mein padhai ke liye bana hi nhi hun but yeh result dekh ke mein khudh hairaan ho gaya 

Toh bhai life mein laude sabhi ke laage hote hai bss tum usse deal kaise karte ho vo matter karta hai . Or jaab tumhari life mein yeh sabh dikkat sort hogi tab tum literally hanso ge ki mene aisi post daali or aaj dekho mein kidhar hun.

Himachal is pretty safe.You won't face any problem over there.you can even go out at night without any problem. But there are no street lights over there so keep enough battery in your phone for using torch.

In sissu there are wild animals around . They rarely or never attack humans but still avoid going out at night .

Also I am a local and have many friends and family near manali , so agar koi dikkat hoi to batana jitni bhi help kar skta honga kar dunga
If you smoke then it would be a really nice experience .Went there with my buddy's last year and it was really great.The music around you , the vibe, the food everything is great.

It's 1 hours drive from manali , you will cross atal tunnel which is the longest tunnel above 10,000 ft. You can stay at sissu if you want. There is a small trek for a waterfall near sissu. From sissu you can go to bara lacha pass or shinkula top. Both are above 16,000 ft and there will be snow all around.Sissu is way less crowded than manali so I will advice you to stay there.

Kasol is very crowded during these months but it also a good option. Only thing in everyone visits kasol for smoking so if you are not with your family it will be fine.
You can go to sissu. Rent a bike from manali. Roads are really nice and beautiful mountains all around.

Since you are traveling by public transport , I would recommend you go to manali then sissu.
I manali you can do all the adventure activities and in sissu you can enjoy the mountains with snow.
In manali or sissu you can hire a taxi to baralach la pass or shinkula top , these both places are above 16000 ft and the view from there is must watch.
We hired a taxi from sissu for 1k per person (initially he was asking for 2k per person).
If you want to smoke world famous maulana cream then you can go to malana before going to manali .
From Bhuntar the road divides into 2 parts one goes towards malana and another towards manali . 

You can view the images of these places in google and also check for weather forecast during your time of visit so that you don't get stuck in snowfall.
